bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided public policy records and used unittest to test transformations on hand-checked input examples.
Cleaned supplied metadata tables in pandas using provided steps, then plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the public report workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, used scikit-learn to compare a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out document groups, checked near-duplicate overlap, and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.
Under supervision, joined report document identifiers to metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
As an individual contribution to supervised research, implemented reusable Python modules for the news metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under research supervision, joined news document identifiers to metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
